reason: A terminal launcher plugin that installs dsh-go, starts the DeepSeek Harness, waits for its local Web UI, and optionally opens it in a browser.

summaries.zh: 安装 dsh-go 终端命令，用于启动 DeepSeek Harness 并在就绪后打开本地 Web 界面。
summaries.en: Installs the dsh-go terminal command to start DeepSeek Harness and open its local Web interface when ready.

capabilities: Generates and updates a launcher script and state files under the user home directory
Starts the dsh harness and polls its local Web UI address
Opens the local Web UI in a browser
May update shell configuration to add the launcher directory to PATH
